name: Matt Coles
bio: Matt Coles | Award-winning UK voice actor and creature vocal designer shaping cinematic worlds across animation, corporate campaigns, and dystopian audio dramas. Best known as the voice of Whiff, Beresford, and Federico in the UK dub of Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go. From smooth corporate storytelling to anatomically crafted monster roars, he breathes life into every character behind the microphone.

credits.title: The Last Days of Napoléon
credits.overview: Exiled to the remote island of Saint Helena, Napoleon Bonaparte spends his final days accompanied by a small circle of attendants. As he wanders the island and goes about his daily routines, fragments of his past resurface in unexpected moments.

credits.title: Thomas & Friends: The Mystery of Lookout Mountain
credits.overview: After Thomas and Percy get spooked by a suspicious rumbling, the engines set off to figure out the secrets of the old mine inside Lookout Mountain.
